subject: Verification of partial service outage, credit eligibility, and post-incident meeting request
messages:
From: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@paywave.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 15:17:00 -0400
Subject: Partial outage observed 2029-05-15 (requesting confirmation & next steps)

Hi Rohan / Laura,

We saw a partial degradation in API availability on 2029-05-15 affecting our checkout flows between 11:02–11:40 PDT (approx). Symptoms: increased 503s for generation endpoints and several timeouts in our payment orchestration, resulting in 1.7% failed transactions for that window. Our SRE captured traces and example request/response pairs — attached as paywave-error-samples-20290515.tar.gz.

We need three things from Redwood to proceed with our internal review:
- A verification of the outage window and whether it meets the SLA definition for "partial outage" under section 4.2 of our contract.
- A preliminary calculation of any proportional credit we are eligible for, or confirmation this event is excluded by the SLA.
- A proposed date/time for a post-incident review (postmortem) with product, SRE, and legal on our side.

We'd like to get a response within 48 hours since this is blocking our executive reporting. Contracts is cc'd for visibility.

Thanks,
Sana Kapoor
Sr. Product Ops Manager — PayWave

---
Attachment: paywave-error-samples-20290515.tar.gz (logs + traces, text bundle)

Hi Sana — thank you for the data and for flagging this. We're investigating now. Quick notes:

- We've triaged SRE traces for your tenant and see an elevated 503 rate concentrated in us-west-2 between 11:00–11:42 PDT.
- I'm asking our incidents team to extract the exact request counts, error taxonomy, and any routing/fallback activity.
- We will treat this as a potential SLA event until the telemetry says otherwise.

Could you confirm the tenant id you used for the attached traces and whether the attached bundle includes the gateway correlation IDs? That will speed up matching.

I will loop back within 24 hours with the verified outage window and a preliminary eligibility note. If eligible, we'll provide a provisional credit estimate and schedule a postmortem.

Regards,

Account Lead — Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@paywave.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2029 09:28:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Partial outage observed 2029-05-15 (requesting confirmation & next steps)

Hi all — SRE update: we pulled the tenant-specific telemetry and validated an availability dip that aligns with PayWave's window. Summary:

- Affected region: us-west-2.
- Observed window (redwood-side): 2029-05-15 18:58:00Z -> 2029-05-15 19:40:00Z (11:58–12:40 PDT).
- Root cause (prelim): a hot-path autoscaler misconfiguration caused a brief exhaustion of warm workers for the generation model pool, which increased cold starts and evictions that cascaded to elevated 503s for a subset of routing keys.
- Total user-facing failure rate for PayWave tenant during window: 1.62% (matches reported 1.7% sample).

Attached is a quick credit worksheet (prelim-credit-calculation-20290518.xlsx) with a proportional calc based on affected requests and our SLA terms. This is preliminary; we need contractual confirmation on the exact SLA metrics to finalize.

Next steps proposed:
1) Confirm the exact metric the customer is invoking (availability vs. success rate anomaly).
2) Agree on the pro-rata credit approach for partial outages (we propose proportional service-days calculation).
3) Book a 60-minute postmortem for next week (I can host the internal side).

Rohan — want me to send the worksheet to Contracts and Legal now or wait for PayWave to confirm?

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Incident Engineer — Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 10:11:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Partial outage observed 2029-05-15 (requesting confirmation & next steps)

Thanks David — appreciate the quick lead on the telemetry. A few clarifications from our side:

- PayWave will invoke the "availability" SLA clause (4.2) as our executive reporting requires a clean availability figure.
- Please use the request-success-rate baseline from March–April 2029 (we can share a 60-day baseline export if you need it).
- For the postmortem, we prefer the window to be Monday 2029-05-20 09:00–10:00 PT. Legal will attend; contracts@paywave.com remains copied.

Two asks before the meeting:
1) A short memo describing the credit calculation method (line items, formula, and timeline for credit issuance).
2) An internal action list showing how Redwood will avoid recurrence of the autoscaler misconfiguration.

If you can provide those by EOD Friday (2029-05-18), we can finalize the meeting and circulate to execs.

Best,
Sana

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
To: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@paywave.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@paywave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Partial outage observed 2029-05-15 (requesting confirmation & next steps)

Hi Sana / PayWave Contracts — following up with the deliverables ahead of the scheduled postmortem:

1) Verification: Redwood confirms the availability dip in us-west-2 during the window identified. We agree this meets the definition of a partial outage under section 4.2 given the tenant-level impact and sustained >1% failure rate across your sampled traffic.

2) Credit calculation memo: attached is the formal memo and the finalized spreadsheet (prelim-credit-calculation-20290518.xlsx updated). Key points:
   - Calculation method: prorated credit based on failed request proportion during the reported window relative to billed request volume; applies only to the generation endpoint routing key specified by PayWave.
   - Result: provisional credit equivalent to 0.72% of May 2029 billed usage for the affected routing key (see spreadsheet for breakdown).
   - Timeline: upon mutual agreement, credit will be issued on the next billing cycle (within 30 days) and applied as account credit.

3) Postmortem meeting: confirmed for Monday, 2029-05-20 09:00 PT (calendar invite sent separately). Agenda: timeline/impact, technical root cause, remediation plan, and credit reconciliation process. Attendees requested: PayWave SRE/Product/Contracts + Redwood SRE/Product/Account.

4) Preventative measures (short):
   - Autoscaler config guard added to infra CI with three safety checks.
   - Warm-worker health telemetry tied to prewarm thresholds and alerting.
   - Runbook updates and canary validation for future autoscaler changes.

If PayWave confirms acceptance of the calculation method and timing, we will proceed to finalize the credit and circulate the postmortem notes within 3 business days after the meeting.

Thanks — Rohan

Rohan Mehta
Account Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-ma-plan-20290520.pdf, prelim-credit-calculation-20290518.xlsx
